description: Permanently delete ONE recorded time block, along with any files attached to it. Before calling it you MUST show the user the block you are about to delete (date, start and end time, project, task and memo, from list_time_blocks) and get an explicit yes for that specific block. Never infer the block from a vague instruction, and never delete several blocks because the user described a range — confirm and delete them one at a time. A deleted block can be put back with restore_time_block for 14 days, after which it and its attachments are purged for good and cannot be recovered; say so when you report the deletion, and do not tell the user the deletion is irreversible. Requires the blocks:delete scope, which is separate from blocks:write and has to be granted deliberately.

block_id.description: From list_time_blocks. Exactly one block is deleted.

name: delete_time_block
